title: Listen to the Sound
about: “Listen to the sound of the angels singing, calling to your heart, praying for your soul — heaven is here, right now.” Tagged simply “Rainbow” in the Songs from the Heart booklet. The melody here follows the singing on Lulu Moon — Listen to the Sound of the Angels Singing (Rainbowsong), a dedicated circle-song take.
